clauses.scope_note: Baidu products, technology, programs, names, marks, and related intellectual property.
clauses.condition_explanation: Use without permission from Baidu or the relevant rights holder is prohibited; the text gives copying, distribution, display, mirroring, uploading, and downloading as examples of unauthorized use.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the identified Baidu intellectual property without permission from Baidu and the relevant rights holder.
obligation_items.object: Baidu products, technology, programs, names, marks, and related intellectual property
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the identified material without the required permission.

clauses.scope_note: Materials, technology, technical support, software, and services provided by either party under the agreement; rights belong to the provider or lawful rights holder.
clauses.condition_explanation: The recipient may not copy the identified material absent express consent from the provider or lawful rights holder.

obligation_items.content: Do not copy the other party's provided material without express consent from the provider or lawful rights holder.
obligation_items.object: Other-party-provided materials, technology, technical support, software, or services
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever copying such material absent express consent.

clauses.scope_note: Materials, technology, technical support, software, and services provided by either party under the agreement; rights belong to the provider or lawful rights holder.
clauses.condition_explanation: The recipient may not distribute the identified material absent express consent from the provider or lawful rights holder.

obligation_items.content: Do not distribute the other party's provided material without express consent from the provider or lawful rights holder.
obligation_items.object: Other-party-provided materials, technology, technical support, software, or services
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever distributing such material absent express consent.

clauses.scope_note: Materials, technology, technical support, software, and services provided by either party under the agreement; rights belong to the provider or lawful rights holder.
clauses.condition_explanation: The recipient may not license the identified material absent express consent from the provider or lawful rights holder.

obligation_items.content: Do not license the other party's provided material without express consent from the provider or lawful rights holder.
obligation_items.object: Other-party-provided materials, technology, technical support, software, or services
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever licensing such material absent express consent.

clauses.scope_note: User-provided information and uploaded data, use of Baidu services, and materials or results involved in that use.
clauses.condition_explanation: The user warrants that the listed materials and service use do not infringe third-party rights. If a third party makes a claim, the user must promptly address it and compensate Baidu for resulting economic losses.

obligation_items.content: Ensure that provided information, uploaded data, service use, and involved materials or resulting work do not infringe third-party lawful rights.
obligation_items.object: User-provided information and data, service use, involved materials, and resulting work
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever providing, uploading, or using the identified material or service.

obligation_items.content: Immediately address a third-party complaint, claim, lawsuit, or other demand concerning the user's information, data, conduct, or work, and compensate Baidu for resulting economic losses, including expenses and compensation payments.
obligation_items.object: Third-party claim concerning user material, conduct, or work, and Baidu's resulting economic losses
obligation_items.trigger: When a third party brings such a complaint, claim, lawsuit, or other demand.

clauses.scope_note: Third-party challenge or complaint concerning intellectual-property ownership of Baidu services.
clauses.condition_explanation: The user must promptly notify Baidu when a third party raises such a challenge or complaint; Baidu is stated to handle it.

obligation_items.content: Promptly notify Baidu of a third-party challenge or complaint concerning intellectual-property ownership of a Baidu service.
obligation_items.object: Baidu service intellectual-property ownership challenge or complaint
obligation_items.trigger: When a third party raises such a challenge or complaint.

clauses.actor_role: Baidu, its affiliates, and necessary sublicensees
clauses.scope_note: User submissions provided to Baidu or posted, uploaded, entered, or submitted to a Baidu service or affiliated service for public or community viewing; use is related to operating Baidu's internet business, including Baidu services.
clauses.condition_explanation: Posting or submitting the defined material grants copying rights for the stated business purpose, including the right to sublicense these rights to service suppliers. Duration, territory, exclusivity, and compensation are not specified.

clauses.actor_role: Baidu, its affiliates, and necessary sublicensees
clauses.scope_note: User submissions provided to Baidu or posted, uploaded, entered, or submitted to a Baidu service or affiliated service for public or community viewing; use is related to operating Baidu's internet business, including Baidu services.
clauses.condition_explanation: Posting or submitting the defined material grants distribution and transmission rights for the stated business purpose, including the right to sublicense these rights to service suppliers. Duration, territory, exclusivity, and compensation are not specified.

clauses.actor_role: Baidu, its affiliates, and necessary sublicensees
clauses.scope_note: User submissions provided to Baidu or posted, uploaded, entered, or submitted to a Baidu service or affiliated service for public or community viewing; includes editing, translation, and reprinting for operation of Baidu's internet business.
clauses.condition_explanation: Posting or submitting the defined material grants the stated modification-related rights for the business purpose, including sublicensing to service suppliers. Duration, territory, exclusivity, and compensation are not specified.

clauses.scope_note: Confidential materials concerning the other party learned during cooperation; obligation survives amendment, rescission, or termination. Exceptions are identified at lines 429-447.
clauses.condition_explanation: A party must not disclose confidential material to third parties in any form except as provided by the agreement, and must restrict employee access and require employees to comply with confidentiality duties.

obligation_items.content: Do not disclose the other party's confidential materials to a third party except as permitted by the agreement; restrict employee access and require employees with access to comply with confidentiality obligations.
obligation_items.object: Confidential materials of the other party learned during cooperation
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever a party or its employees have access to those materials, subject to agreement-permitted exceptions.

clauses.scope_note: Confidential materials of either party; duty survives amendment, rescission, or termination.
clauses.condition_explanation: Each party must use best efforts to protect confidential materials and, upon discovering a leak, cooperate in reasonable measures to avoid or mitigate harm.

obligation_items.content: Use best efforts to protect confidential materials from disclosure and, upon discovering a leak, cooperate in reasonable measures to avoid or mitigate resulting harm.
obligation_items.trigger: Throughout the confidentiality obligation; cooperation is triggered upon discovery of a leak.
